secondaryFinding: While constructing the sc-7-2 test, an override writing status:'completed' WITHOUT version silently lost the fixture's channel-join tie-break to the seeded contract: neither side sets version, and the canonicalJson string tie-break happens to favour 'passed' (sorts after 'in-progress') but NOT 'completed' (sorts before it). Not a production bug — specific to how the test override was first written — but a real load-bearing subtlety in reducers.ts's versionRank fallback that the golden fixture's gate_sprint_out body dodges only by the alphabetics of the word 'passed'. Fixed by setting version:1 on the override, mirroring what sprint_exit does in production.
